output.narrative:
The attacker used multiple techniques to gain persistence on the system, starting with creating a new account named 'oop' via the following commands:
cmd.exe /c cmd /c \\\"cd /d \\D:\\\phpStudy\\WWW\\\\\\& net user oop o33 /add & echo \\\[S\\\\]\\\\\\& cd & echo \\\[E\\\\]\\\\"
and modifying the registry keys related to Remote Desktop services to enable remote access.
The adversary also added a scheduled task using the 'ngentask.exe' to execute a PowerShell script as part of a lateral movement technique.
Additionally, they modified the Image File Execution Options of sethc.exe to point to cmd.exe, allowing them to create a backdoor and maintain persistence on the system.
